title: Quiz: Python Timer Functions: Three Ways to Monitor Your Code
description: Test your knowledge of Python timer functions, from time.perf_counter() to timers built with classes, context managers, and decorators.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Python Timer Functions: Three Ways to Monitor Your Code . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit why time.perf_counter() is the go-to clock for timing code and how to wrap a timer in a class, a context manager, and a decorator.
